text: The Cambridge brand group wants to put together a shipment - 6o0 pcs total - to the sales meeting in Dallas at the end
February. It can be shipped palletized, but will consist of 6o0 individual 'gifts'. Each package would contain 3-4
cosmetic/health/beauty aid type items - soaps, gels, etc. One item is breakable - glass bottle. All need to be packaged
in a glossy paper bag, dimension of the bag are 8"x4"x10" (8" wide, 4" deep, 10" tall). Please advise if this is a project
you want to take on, an estimated cost for packaging (bubble wrap, individual box per shipment), labor to pre-
pack/assemble, and a rough transportation cost.
Timing - items received by end Jan, 2 weeks or so to pack up, ship mid Feb to Dallas.
Samples not presently available, but would be sometime this week/early next week.
